name: Giving To Your Pastor
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of generous giving, promising that those who give liberally will themselves be blessed and enriched, while withholding leads to poverty (Proverbs 11:24-25). Specifically, God commands that the firstfruits and offerings be given to the priests to ensure His blessing rests upon the household (Ezekiel 44:30). The practice of bringing tithes into the storehouse is presented as a way to support the work of God's house and a means to receive abundant blessings from the Lord (Malachi 3:10). Furthermore, receiving and supporting those who minister the Word, such as prophets and righteous men, results in sharing in their spiritual reward (Matthew 10:41), reflecting the biblical principle of honoring those who labor in preaching and teaching the gospel (Luke 8:1).
